author: Rudyard Kipling
title: Just So Stories
edition: Garden City, New York: Doubleday, Page & Company, 1912; Project Gutenberg transcription of the illustrated edition. Author illustration captions are omitted with the illustrations. Paragraph line wrapping and HTML spacing are normalized; verse line and stanza boundaries are retained. Image-only initial letters are restored from their source alt text and joined to the following word. Page numbers, images, illustration captions, and publisher/digitizer matter are omitted. The library text holds the whole book: the book title as a level-1 heading and the twelve story titles at level 2, each story's prose followed by its verses as stanzas with display indentation removed; the title, copyright and contents pages, the transcriber's notes, the illustrations with Kipling's captions, and the printer's closing imprint are omitted.

rights.basis: This original English edition was published in 1912, before 1931; its US publication copyright term has expired as of 2026. No modern introduction or illustrations are included.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg HTML (pg32488-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror) parsed with Python's html.parser: the PG header, footer and licence, transcriber's notes, page-number markers, illustration captions (caption, caption2), the frontispiece, title, copyright and contents pages, and the closing Country Life Press imprint dropped. JUST SO STORIES became the level-1 heading and each story title a level-2 heading. Each decorative initial image's alt text (one letter, or the whole words NOT and HEAR) was joined to the paragraph that follows it, with a space only where the source has one. Paragraph and unindented divisions became paragraph blocks with whitespace runs folded to single spaces; each poem division was split into stanzas at its blank lines, with HTML line breaks kept as lines and their indentation removed; italics rendered as plain text. Straight quotation marks and em dashes kept as transcribed. Every Grade 3 night from this book was located block for block.
